description.value: Esquimalt Roasting Company is a small-batch specialty coffee roastery nestled in Esquimalt on Vancouver Island, sourcing and roasting single-origin and blended coffees on-site. The company operates two cafe locations in the greater Esquimalt/Victoria area and sells freshly roasted beans online with local delivery. A touring cyclist can expect quality specialty coffee drinks and whole-bean options from a locally rooted roaster with a distinct community focus.
